name: Android Emulator
author: Ebenezer Nana Ofosu
description: Android Virtual Devices in the Omarchy bar: start/stop with live boot state, create new AVDs, and screenshot, install APKs, reverse Metro and tail logcat on running ones.

barWidget.description: Start and stop Android Virtual Devices and create new ones from the bar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll `emuctl list` for AVD state. The panel also refreshes on open and after every action.

schema.label: adb reverse ports
schema.description: Ports forwarded from each emulator to this machine (adb reverse) every time one finishes booting, e.g. "8081" for Metro or "8081, 3000". Leave empty to turn off.

schema.label: Notify when ready
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when an emulator finishes booting. Failed starts are always notified.
